model.title: VA Fiscal Management Modernization Act
model.meta: Veterans' Affairs Committee · Rep. Jack Bergman (R-MI)

summary.text: The bill would strengthen and clarify the management authority of the Department of Veterans Affairs' Assistant Secretary for Management, giving this official expanded powers to oversee the department's operations and finances. It aims to modernize how the VA handles administrative and fiscal responsibilities to improve organizational effectiveness.
